text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To every Umamusume, the winning
concert is a
stage of dreams.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To stand center stage is the mark of a
victor, and
to sing into a microphone is
an honor that
precious few earn.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So when they sing, each and every word
carries
with it the joy of this triumph...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...And the gratitude they feel toward the
fans who
pushed them up into the
spotlight.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Y-you did great out there. Though it's a
shame
that you, um...

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
Heh, absolutely dazzling, wasn't I? ...As
a backup
dancer, like always.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
...I don't know how you do it. How are
you able to
go full out with a smile like
that?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
No one would notice if a backup dancer
didn't
give 100%. Why not save it for
when you can be
center?

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
The people cheering for me... they'll
cheer for me
no matter where on stage
I'm standing.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
Just like you did today. I owe it to them
to always
give it my all, no matter what.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
Besides... Hello, do you know why they
started
doing winning concerts in the
first place?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Because runners wanted a chance to
express their
gratitude to fans after a
win, right?

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
That's right. We get up on stage and
sing to thank
our fans for coming to see
us on our big day, for
supporting us.

text_block_list.name: Hello's Upperclassman
text_block_list.text:
But actually, the true origin story's a
little
different. Apparently...

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(Her smile back then was truly dazzling,
as if
there could be nothing behind it
besides pure
joy.)

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
(But behind that pure emotion, I
couldn't help but
notice a tinge of
sadness hiding in the corners.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As debut races inch closer, the students
are
starting to put effort into concert
practice in
addition to their usual
training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, as I'm passing by the stage...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, you can put a little more spirit
into it than
that!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ughhh, but we're just rehearsing. We
don't need
to be all serious about it.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Remember what the teacher said?
Rehearse like
it's the real thing. So I
want to see big smiles!

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
...I'm good. If we're pretending it's the
real thing,
then I definitely shouldn't be
smiling.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I mean, this choreo is for backup
dancers.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ah... That's true, but...

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
I dunno about you, but I don't want to
get too
used to this dance. If I can get
through it with a
smile, it means I'll never
reach center stage.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Don't get me wrong—if I end up as
backup, I'll
dance. I'm not gonna ruin the
star's show.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: B-but still...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I don't like that attitude! Concerts aren't
just
about being center, are they?

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Think about all the fans who'll be there
to see
you—why don't we rehearse one
more time, for
their sakes?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: ...You don't get it. Of course you can talk big!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The student kicks up dirt and lunges at
Smart
Falcon—time to step in!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I manage to pull them apart and diffuse
the
tension.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: S-sorry you had to get involved in this...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... It was totally my fault. I need to apologize to her too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
...Part of me knew that maybe I was
being a little
too pushy.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, thanks for trying to make me feel better, but nothing she said was wrong either.
choice_data_list: Still, what you said was right too.
But what you said was also right.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it'd be better if we didn't split
people up
into center stage or backup
dancers or anything...

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
No, that wouldn't be right. It's the
serious
competition before a winning
concert that makes
it so special! That's
why everyone dreams of
standing center
stage!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Sigh... Yeah, you're right.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Here's one! How about we bring back
the Grand
Concert?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Hello Trainer, and Smart Falcon.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
You're totally right to feel conflicted.
Which is
why I'm here with a solution to
your problem!

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text: Wh-wha? ...Who are you?

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text: Oh, silly me. I'm Light Hello.

text_block_list.name: Light Hello
text_block_list.text:
Event producer and leader of the Grand
Concert
Reboot Project!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And that's how I met Light Hello, the
mysterious
event producer.
